title: Grainy Ligne-Claire
description: Illustration pop-art plate et très saturée, définie par des contours noirs uniformes. Caractérisée par l'absence totale d'ombrage, des aplats de couleurs unies et une forte texture granuleuse de type risographie.
description_en: Flat, highly saturated pop-art illustration defined by uniform black monoweight outlines. Characterized by a total absence of shading, solid color fills, and a heavy, uniform risograph-style paper grain overlay.
description_fr: Illustration pop-art plate et très saturée, définie par des contours noirs uniformes. Caractérisée par l'absence totale d'ombrage, des aplats de couleurs unies et une forte texture granuleuse de type risographie.
prompt: Flat digital illustration, vintage ligne claire comic style, risograph print aesthetic. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space, no borders, no frames, no white margins, full bleed to all four corners. Execute all visual elements using uniform, thin, crisp black monoweight contour lines that encase every distinct shape perfectly. The pen pressure is completely unvarying, creating a rigid but clean graphic boundary around all objects. Fill these outlines with pure, unshaded solid color blocks utilizing {{primary_color}}, {{accent_color}}, and {{secondary_color}}. Strictly avoid any gradients, soft blending, ambient occlusion, or volumetric rendering. The lighting is absolutely flat, featuring zero directional shadows, zero specular highlights, and zero rim lights, relying exclusively on pure local color. Overlay the entire composition with a heavy, uniform digital noise and risograph-style paper grain. This tactile, speckled texture must be visible across all solid color fills and negative spaces, mimicking the look of cheap vintage newsprint or indie zine printing. Ensure every edge remains sharp and perfectly defined by the black ink contour, preventing any color bleed outside the lines. The overall contrast is high, driven by the juxtaposition of saturated hues against the stark black linework. Spatial dynamics are strictly flat and 2D, establishing depth solely through the overlapping of these crisp, hard-edged silhouettes without any atmospheric perspective.
